instruction: Kapas mein bollworm ka kya ilaj hai
output: Kapas mein bollworm ke liye Bt cotton varieties use karo. Chemical control: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC 2ml/litre spray karo. Pheromone traps bhi lagao.

instruction: Mitti ka pH test ghar par kaise karein
output: Soil pH test kit chemist se milti hai ya krishi vibhag ki lab mein free testing hoti hai. Neutral pH 6.5-7.5 sabse achha hota hai.

instruction: Aam ke ped mein kaunsa fertilizer
output: Aam ke liye NPK 12:32:16 mix 500g per tree daalo bursaat se pehle. Zinc sulphate bhi daalo agar leaves pili ho rahi hain.
